// Fixture de l'auto-test de check_no_hardcoded_colors.cmake : chaque ligne marquee
// par le marqueur de fin de ligne ci-dessous (deux barres, espace, le mot en
// majuscules) doit etre signalee, et AUCUNE autre.
#include <QColor>
#include "design_tokens.hpp"

void violations() {
    QPen a(QColor(80, 120, 200)); // VIOLATION
    QPen b(QColor(0xB0, 0x30, 0x30)); // VIOLATION
    QColor c = QColor{12, 34, 56}; // VIOLATION
    const QColor kInk(0x5C, 0x62, 0x6A); // VIOLATION
    QColor fill{1, 2, 3}; // VIOLATION
    painter->fillRect(canvas, Qt::white); // VIOLATION
    painter->setPen(Qt::black); // VIOLATION
    brush.setColor(Qt::darkGray); // VIOLATION
    brush.setColor(Qt::lightGray); // VIOLATION
    QPen pen(Qt::red, 2); // VIOLATION
    auto warn = QColor(Qt::green); // VIOLATION
    label->setStyleSheet("#8a5a00"); // VIOLATION
    label->setStyleSheet("color:#8a5a00;"); // VIOLATION
    const char* white = "#ffffff"; // VIOLATION
    const char* alpha = "#11223344"; // VIOLATION
    const char* shortHex = "#fff"; // VIOLATION
    const char* shortAlpha = "#fff8"; // VIOLATION
    swatch->setStyleSheet("background: rgba(1,2,3,4)"); // VIOLATION
    swatch->setStyleSheet(QStringLiteral("background-color: rgb(%1,%2,%3);")); // VIOLATION
    swatch->setStyleSheet(QStringLiteral("rgba(%1,%2,%3,%4)")); // VIOLATION
    swatch->setStyleSheet("color: hsl(120, 50%, 50%)"); // VIOLATION
    QColor fromText("#ff0000"); // VIOLATION
    QColor named("red"); // VIOLATION
    auto d = QColor::fromRgb(1, 2, 3); // VIOLATION
    auto e = QColor::fromRgbF(0.5, 0.5, 0.5); // VIOLATION
    auto f = QColor::fromHsv(10, 20, 30); // VIOLATION
    QRgb g = qRgb(1, 2, 3); // VIOLATION
    QRgb h = qRgba(0xFF, 0, 0, 0xFF); // VIOLATION
    color.setNamedColor("tomato"); // VIOLATION
    QPen multi(QColor( // VIOLATION
        200,
        90,
        40));
    QColor multiDecl( // VIOLATION
        12, 34, 56);
    QColor multiBrace{ // VIOLATION
        0x10, 0x20, 0x30};
    QColor stray = Qt::yellow; // VIOLATION
    /* commentaire */ QColor afterBlock(9, 9, 9); // VIOLATION
    const char* url = "http://example.com/"; QColor afterUrl(7, 7, 7); // VIOLATION
    char quote = '"'; QColor afterQuote(8, 8, 8); // VIOLATION
    int big = 1'000'000; QColor afterSeparator(6, 6, 6); // VIOLATION
    // l'apostrophe d'un commentaire ne doit pas masquer la ligne suivante
    QColor afterApostrophe(5, 5, 5); // VIOLATION
    /* bloc sur
       plusieurs lignes, avec une apostrophe : l'etat */
    QColor afterMultiBlock(4, 4, 4); // VIOLATION
}

#define BAD_COLOR "#abcdef" // VIOLATION

const char* kSheet = R"qss(
QPushButton { color: #123456; } // VIOLATION
QLabel { color: @text@; }
)qss";
